entities.summary: Michael Wolff is an American journalist and media consultant, as well as a columnist and contributor to USA Today and The Hollywood Reporter. He has received two National Magazine Awards, a Mirror Award, and has authored seven books, including Burn Rate (1998) about his own dot-com company, and The Man Who Owns the News (2008), a biography of Rupert Murdoch. He co-founded the news aggregation website Newser and is a former editor of Adweek. Michael Wolff was a performers & entertainers from Paterson (b. 1953-08-27, Paterson). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
